DTX.headline: Breezy NE winds, Small Craft Advisories; low rain chance near Ohio border

areas.label: Small Craft Advisory, NE 20-30 kt
areas.quote: Gales remain unlikely though onshore flow warrants long duration Small Craft Advisories for all nearshore waters.

areas.label: Low rain chance near Ohio border
areas.quote: There remains a lower end rain chance near the Ohio border, as shortwave energy rippling thru the southern stream into the Ohio valley may engage the deeper moisture still lingering near the Michigan-Ohio border.

APX.headline: Frost likely in interior Eastern Upper tonight; dry high pressure otherwise

areas.label: Frost likely, interior E Upper
areas.quote:
Interior Eastern Upper will very likely see frost development in the 
morning while interior northern lower remains in the upper 30s.

areas.label: Patchy frost, interior N Lower
areas.quote:
Patchy frost is still expected to develop, but will remain more 
localized compared to eastern upper.

areas.label: Small craft advisory, N Lake Michigan
areas.quote:
Small Craft Advisory until 8 PM EDT this evening for LHZ348-
     349.

MQT.headline: Rip currents today in Marquette Co; widespread frost west UP Tuesday AM

areas.label: High rip current risk, Marquette Co
areas.quote:
Hazardous swimming conditions and high rip current risks are 
present through this afternoon for Marquette County due to high wave 
heights from the northeast.

areas.label: Widespread frost western UP
areas.quote:
widespread frost is likely (50-80%) in the western UP Tuesday 
morning, and patchy frost is possible (20-40%) elsewhere away 
from shorelines.
